SYMPTOM: History page showed few or no items even though recordings existed. Frontend kept requesting more pages but each returned fewer items.
CAUSE: `get_total_count()` returned full index count (9,237 entries) including entries without meta.json. Pagination loop skipped invalid entries via parse_history_item returning None, but `has_more = offset + limit < 9237` was always true. Frontend was stuck in infinite pagination loop returning empty pages.
FIX: Added `load_unified_history_with_count()` in `history/service.rs` that returns `(items, total_valid)` in a single pass. Command handler uses this instead of calling `get_total_count()` separately. `has_more = items.len() == limit && offset + limit < total_valid`.
PREVENT: Never use two separate methods for total count and item fetch — they can diverge. Single-pass count is the only way to ensure consistency.
